frontend_behavior.numeric_serialization_note: The stock frontend normally stringifies numeric JSON values unless its toStringData option is disabled.

transport.success_rule: HTTP 200 is not sufficient by itself. Inspect the method response; for disruptive writes use reconnect/read-back.

verification_statuses.LIVE_VERIFIED: Successfully exercised on the tested NR2301 runtime. Some actions have side effects; check the safety class and notes.
verification_statuses.LIVE_VERIFIED_LIMITED: Live evidence exists, but only for a limited transport/context or with an incomplete behavioral result.
verification_statuses.LIVE_DENIED: The method was reached live but normal administrator authorization was denied.
verification_statuses.LIVE_REJECTED: The backend was reached live and rejected the tested request.
verification_statuses.LIVE_NOT_APPLICABLE: The method exists but the tested runtime/state did not provide an applicable live case.
verification_statuses.STATIC_CONFIRMED: Referenced by the shipped frontend/firmware, but not intentionally live-executed in this research set.
verification_statuses.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Referenced statically, but the tested backend returned method-not-found.
verification_statuses.UNTESTED: No sufficient static or live evidence has been normalized yet.
